name: CUET UG
notes: NTA states the KB band and 'recent passport-size colour photograph'; 200x230 px is the pixel equivalent NTA portals use across JEE, NEET and CUET.
Face must occupy about 80% of the frame, including the ears, with no mask.
Signature is a separate upload at 10-50 KB - wider than the 4-30 KB band NTA uses for JEE and NEET.
Uploads are screened by an automatic validation system that rejects wrong size, format or clarity at the portal.
